lessons.description: Talking about food and dinner table interactions.

sentences.english: I am really hungry.
Dinner is ready.
This food is delicious.
Can you pass me the rice?
I would like some water.
Please eat more vegetables.

conversation_script.text_en: Mom, I am really hungry. Is dinner ready?
conversation_script.text_zh: 妈妈，我很饿。晚饭好了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, dinner is ready. Come and sit down.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好了，来坐下吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Wow, it smells great.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哇，闻起来真香。

conversation_script.text_en: Please try the chicken.
conversation_script.text_zh: 尝尝鸡肉吧。

conversation_script.text_en: It's delicious. Can I have some more?
conversation_script.text_zh: 真好吃。我能再来一点吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course. Help yourself.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然，自己拿吧。

lessons.description: Simple conversations in the morning.

sentences.english: Good morning.
Did you sleep well?
Breakfast is ready.
What is your plan today?
Have a great day.
The weather looks nice.

conversation_script.text_en: Good morning.
conversation_script.text_zh: 早上好。

conversation_script.text_en: Good morning. Did you sleep well?
conversation_script.text_zh: 早上好。你睡得好吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I slept very well.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我睡得很好。

conversation_script.text_en: Breakfast is ready.
conversation_script.text_zh: 早餐准备好了。

conversation_script.text_en: Great. What are we having?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。我们吃什么？

conversation_script.text_en: Eggs, bread, and milk.
conversation_script.text_zh: 鸡蛋、面包和牛奶。

lessons.description: Talking about activities before sleep.

sentences.english: I am tired.
It's time for bed.
Brush your teeth first.
Can you read me a story?
Good night.
Sweet dreams.

conversation_script.text_en: Mom, I'm tired.
conversation_script.text_zh: 妈妈，我累了。

conversation_script.text_en: It's time for bed then.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那该睡觉了。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you read me a story?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你能给我讲个故事吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure, but brush your teeth first.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然，不过先刷牙。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, I'll do it now.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我现在去。

conversation_script.text_en: Good night and sweet dreams.
conversation_script.text_zh: 晚安，做个好梦。

lessons.description: Talking about family plans and activities on weekends.

sentences.english: What are we doing this weekend?
Let's go to the park.
We can have a picnic.
That sounds fun.
We enjoy spending time together.
sentences.chinese: 我们喜欢一起度过时光。

sentences.english: Let's take some pictures.

conversation_script.text_en: Do we have any plans this weekend?
conversation_script.text_zh: 这个周末有什么计划吗？

conversation_script.text_en: How about going to the park?
conversation_script.text_zh: 去公园怎么样？

conversation_script.text_en: That sounds fun.
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来很有趣。

conversation_script.text_en: We can have a picnic there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们可以在那里野餐。

conversation_script.text_en: Can we ride our bikes too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们也能骑自行车吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course. Let's enjoy the day together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。让我们一起享受这一天。

lessons.description: Talking about family photos and special memories.

sentences.english: Look at this old photo.
I remember that day.
We were on vacation.
Everyone looks happy.
sentences.chinese: 每个人看起来都很开心。

sentences.english: This is a special memory.
Let's make a new photo album.
sentences.chinese: 我们做一本新的相册吧。

conversation_script.text_en: What are you looking at?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你在看什么？

conversation_script.text_en: I'm looking at our family photos.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我在看我们的家庭照片。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, I remember that vacation.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，我记得那次假期。

conversation_script.text_en: We had a great time there.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们在那里玩得很开心。

conversation_script.text_en: Everyone was smiling.
conversation_script.text_zh: 每个人都在微笑。

conversation_script.text_en: These photos bring back good memories.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这些照片带来了美好的回忆。

lessons.description: Offering help around the house and doing daily chores together.

sentences.english: Can I help you, Dad?
Please clean your bedroom.
Let's pick up the toys.
I can take out the trash.
Thank you for helping me.
You did a great job!

conversation_script.text_en: Can you help me clean the living room?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你能帮我打扫一下客厅吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! What should I do first?
conversation_script.text_zh: 没问题！我先做什么？

conversation_script.text_en: Please put your toys back in the box.
conversation_script.text_zh: 请把你的玩具放回盒子里。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, I will do that right now. Can I sweep the floor too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我这就去。我也可以扫地吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, please. The broom is behind the door.
conversation_script.text_zh: 可以，麻烦了。扫帚在门后面。

conversation_script.text_en: Look! Everything is clean now.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你看！现在全干净了。

conversation_script.text_en: Wow, you did an amazing job! Thank you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哇，你做得太棒了！谢谢你。

lessons.description: Sharing toys, playing games, and resolving small conflicts between brothers and sisters.

sentences.english: Can I play with you?
It's my turn now.
Please share your markers with me.
sentences.chinese: 请把你的马克笔分享给我用用。

sentences.english: Don't be angry, I'm sorry.
Let's play a video game together.
sentences.chinese: 我们一起玩电子游戏吧。

sentences.english: You can borrow my book.

conversation_script.text_en: Hey, what are you playing?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嘿，你在玩什么呢？

conversation_script.text_en: I'm building a big castle with blocks.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我在用积木搭一座大城堡。

conversation_script.text_en: It looks cool! Can I play with you?
conversation_script.text_zh: 看起来好酷！我可以和你一起玩吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, but you have to share the blue blocks.
conversation_script.text_zh: 行，但你得把蓝色积木分我玩。

conversation_script.text_en: Deal. Can I build the tower?
conversation_script.text_zh: 一言为定。我可以来搭塔楼吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, let's build it really high!
conversation_script.text_zh: 可以，我们把它搭得超级高吧！

lessons.description: Calling grandparents or relatives and chatting about your day over video.

sentences.english: Let's call Grandma and Grandpa.
sentences.chinese: 我们给爷爷奶奶/外公外婆打个视频吧。

sentences.english: Can you hear me clearly?
Your screen is frozen.
We miss you so much!
Wave hello to the camera.
sentences.chinese: 对着摄像头招手说你好。

sentences.english: Talk a bit louder, please.

conversation_script.text_en: Hello! Oh, I can't see you very well.
conversation_script.text_zh: 喂！噢，我看得不太清楚。

conversation_script.text_en: Hi Grandma! Is it better now? I moved closer.
conversation_script.text_zh: 外婆好！现在好点了吗？我凑近了点。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, perfect! How was your school today?
conversation_script.text_zh: 看清了，太好了！今天在学校怎么样啊？

conversation_script.text_en: It was great! I got an A on my art project.
conversation_script.text_zh: 特别棒！我的美术作业拿了个A呢。

conversation_script.text_en: I am so proud of you! Show me the picture.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真为你骄傲！快把画给我看看。

conversation_script.text_en: Here it is! Can you see the colors?
conversation_script.text_zh: 在这儿！你能看到这些颜色吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Beautiful! Thank you for calling me, sweetheart.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真漂亮！谢谢你给我打视频，宝贝。

lessons.description: Making meals as a family and learning kitchen vocabulary safely.

sentences.english: What are we cooking for dinner?
Please wash the tomatoes.
Be careful, the stove is very hot.
Can you stir the soup gently?
sentences.chinese: 你能轻轻地搅一下汤吗？

sentences.english: Don't touch the sharp knife.
Put on your apron first.

conversation_script.text_en: We are making spaghetti tonight. Want to help?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们今晚做意大利面。想来帮忙吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, please! I love spaghetti. What can I do?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好呀好呀！我最喜欢意大利面了。我能做什么？

conversation_script.text_en: You can wash these mushrooms in the sink.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你可以去水槽里把这些蘑菇洗了。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. Should I cut them after washing?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。洗完之后需要我切开它们吗？

conversation_script.text_en: No, I will use the knife. It's too sharp for you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不用，我来拿刀切。刀太快了，你用不安全。

conversation_script.text_en: Alright. Can I stir the meat sauce then?
conversation_script.text_zh: 那好吧。一会儿我可以搅拌肉酱吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, you can do that when the pot is ready.
conversation_script.text_zh: 可以，等锅烧热准备好了你就来搅吧。

lessons.description: Getting the plates, utensils, and napkins ready right before family mealtime.

sentences.english: Dinner is almost ready! Let's set the table.
sentences.chinese: 晚饭马上好啦！我们来摆饭桌吧。

sentences.english: How many plates do we need?
We need four pairs of chopsticks.
Put a napkin next to each plate.
sentences.chinese: 在每个盘子旁边放一张餐巾纸。

sentences.english: Pass me the spoons, please.
Everyone sit down, please.

conversation_script.text_en: Dinner is ready! Can someone set the table?
conversation_script.text_zh: 晚饭好啦！谁来摆一下桌子？

conversation_script.text_en: I can do it! How many people are eating tonight?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我来！今晚有几个人吃饭？

conversation_script.text_en: Just the four of us. Count out the bowls and plates.
conversation_script.text_zh: 就我们四个。数出四个碗和四个盘子吧。

conversation_script.text_en: One, two, three, four. Done! Do we need forks or chopsticks?
conversation_script.text_zh: 一、二、三、四。好了！我们需要叉子还是筷子？

conversation_script.text_en: Chopsticks for Mom and Dad, and forks for you and your sister.
conversation_script.text_zh: 爸爸妈妈用筷子，你和姐姐用叉子。

conversation_script.text_en: Got it. I will put water glasses on the table too.
conversation_script.text_zh: 明白。我顺便把水杯也摆到桌上。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you, sweetie. Now everything looks perfect.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢你，宝贝。现在一切都完美了。

lessons.description: Cleaning up the kitchen together, washing plates, and drying utensils safely.

sentences.english: Let's wash the dishes together.
Put some soap on the sponge.
Be careful, the plate is slippery.
Can you rinse these bowls for me?
sentences.chinese: 你能帮我把这些碗冲洗干净吗？

sentences.english: Use this towel to dry the cups.
sentences.chinese: 用这块抹布把杯子擦干。

sentences.english: Put the clean spoons in the drawer.
sentences.chinese: 把干净的勺子放进抽屉里。

conversation_script.text_en: There are a lot of dishes tonight. Let's do them together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 今晚有好多碗要洗。我们一块儿洗吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay! I can wash and you can rinse.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好呀！我来刷洗，你来冲水。

conversation_script.text_en: Sounds like a plan. Here is the sponge and the soap.
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来不错。给你海绵和洗洁精。

conversation_script.text_en: Look at all these bubbles! It's kind of fun.
conversation_script.text_zh: 看这些泡泡！还挺好玩的。

conversation_script.text_en: Haha, yes. Please pass me that big plate so I can dry it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哈哈，是的。请把那个大盘子递给我，我把它擦干。

conversation_script.text_en: Here you go. Are we all finished now?
conversation_script.text_zh: 给你。我们现在都忙完了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! The counter is clean and the kitchen looks great.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！台面很干净，厨房看起来棒极了。

lessons.description: Playing board games or cards together on the weekend and practicing fair play.

sentences.english: It is family game night tonight!
Which board game do you want to play?
Please roll the dice.
Whose turn is it now?
You need to follow the rules.
Good game! That was really close.
sentences.chinese: 玩得好！刚才真危险/比分真接近。

conversation_script.text_en: Let's play a game together. I have a new board game!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们一起玩个游戏吧。我有一个新桌游！

conversation_script.text_en: Awesome! How do we play it?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！这个怎么玩？

conversation_script.text_en: We take turns rolling the dice and moving our pieces.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们轮流掷骰子，然后移动棋子。

conversation_script.text_en: Can I go first?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我可以先开始吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure, roll the dice. You got a six!
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然可以，摇骰子吧。你摇到了一个6！

conversation_script.text_en: Yay! Look how far I can move. This is so much fun.
conversation_script.text_zh: 耶！看我能走多远。这真的太好玩了。

conversation_script.text_en: It is! Even if we lose, it is just a game.
conversation_script.text_zh: 确实！哪怕输了，也只是个游戏嘛。

lessons.description: Choosing a movie or a show to watch together and sharing opinions about it.

sentences.english: What do you want to watch tonight?
Where is the remote control?
Please turn down the volume, it is too loud.
Let's make some popcorn before the movie.
sentences.chinese: 电影开始前我们做点爆米花吧。

sentences.english: This cartoon is very funny.
I don't like scary movies.

conversation_script.text_en: Do you want to watch a movie with us on the couch?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你想和我们一块儿坐在沙发上看电影吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I do! What movie are we watching?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好呀！我们在看什么电影？

conversation_script.text_en: We can't decide. Do you want a funny movie or an adventure movie?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们还没决定。你想要看搞笑片还是冒险片？

conversation_script.text_en: An adventure movie sounds exciting! Let's choose that one.
conversation_script.text_zh: 冒险电影听起来很刺激！我们就选那个吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. Can you find the remote and turn it up a bit?
conversation_script.text_zh: 行。你能找一下遥控器，然后把声音调大一点吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Found it. I will pass the popcorn over too.
conversation_script.text_zh: 找到了。我也把爆米花递过去。

conversation_script.text_en: Perfect, sit down. The movie is starting right now!
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了，坐下吧。电影马上就要开始了！

lessons.description: Sharing favorite songs, dancing in the living room, and enjoying rhythms.

sentences.english: Listen to this beautiful song.
Who is your favorite singer?
Can you play a happy song?
sentences.chinese: 你能放一首欢快的歌吗？

sentences.english: Let's dance together in the living room.
sentences.chinese: 我们一起在客厅跳个舞吧。

sentences.english: I like to sing along with the music.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢跟着音乐一起唱。

sentences.english: Turn on the wireless speaker, please.

conversation_script.text_en: What kind of music are you listening to?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你在听什么类型的音乐？

conversation_script.text_en: It is a pop song. It has a really fast beat.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是一首流行歌曲。它的节奏很快。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, I like it! It makes me want to dance.
conversation_script.text_zh: 噢，我喜欢！它让我想跳舞了。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too! Let's clear some space and dance.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是！我们让出点空地来跳舞吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you know the words to this song?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你知道这首歌的歌词吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I do. Let's sing along together at the chorus!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我知道。副歌部分我们一起跟着大声唱吧！

conversation_script.text_en: That was awesome. Music always makes me feel happy.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了。音乐总能让我感到开心。

lessons.description: Planting flowers, watering the garden, and taking care of plants outside.

sentences.english: Let's help Grandpa in the yard today.
sentences.chinese: 我们今天去院子里帮帮爷爷/外公吧。

sentences.english: We are going to plant some flower seeds.
sentences.chinese: 我们准备种一些鲜花种子。

sentences.english: Please give the plants some water.
Look at this little green leaf!
Don't get your clothes too dirty.
Plants need sunlight to grow.

conversation_script.text_en: Grandma, what are you doing in the garden?
conversation_script.text_zh: 奶奶/外婆，你在花园里做什么呢？

conversation_script.text_en: I am planting some red roses. Do you want to help?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我在种一些红玫瑰。你想来帮忙吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! Can I dig the small holes in the dirt?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好呀！我可以在土里挖小坑吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course. Use this small shovel, and be gentle.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然可以。用这把小铲子，动作要轻一点。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. Should I put the seeds inside now?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。现在需要我把种子放进去吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, put two seeds in each hole and cover them with dirt.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，每个坑里放两颗种子，然后用土盖上。

conversation_script.text_en: Done! Now I will water them so they grow big and beautiful.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好啦！现在我要给它们浇水，好让它们长得又大又漂亮。

lessons.description: Getting suitcases ready, picking clothes, and remembering travel essentials.

sentences.english: We need to pack our suitcases tonight.
sentences.chinese: 我们今晚需要收拾行李箱。

sentences.english: Don't forget your toothbrush!
How many t-shirts do I need?
Let's check our packing list.
sentences.chinese: 我们来看看打包清单吧。

sentences.english: I am so excited for our vacation.
sentences.chinese: 我对我们的假期感到太兴奋了。

sentences.english: Put your shoes in a separate bag.
sentences.chinese: 把你的鞋子装进一个单独的袋子里。

conversation_script.text_en: Our trip is tomorrow! Are you ready to pack your bag?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们明天就要旅行了！你准备好收拾包了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! Can I bring my favorite blue jacket?
conversation_script.text_zh: 准备好了！我可以带上我最喜欢的那件蓝色外套吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course. It might be cold in the evening.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然可以。晚上可能会有点冷。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. How many pairs of socks should I take?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。我应该带几双袜子？

conversation_script.text_en: Take three pairs. And make sure to find your pajamas.
conversation_script.text_zh: 带三双吧。还有一定要找到你的睡衣。

conversation_script.text_en: I put them in the suitcase already. Look!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我已经把它们放进行李箱了。你看！

conversation_script.text_en: Great job! You are getting very good at this.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！你对这个越来越拿手了。

lessons.description: Returning from a trip, putting things away, and settling back into the house.

sentences.english: It feels so good to be back home.
Let's unpack our clothes right now.
sentences.chinese: 我们现在就把衣服拿出来放好吧。

sentences.english: Put all the dirty clothes in the laundry basket.
sentences.chinese: 把所有脏衣服都放到洗衣篮里。

sentences.english: Where should I put this souvenir?
sentences.chinese: 我应该把这个纪念品放在哪里？

sentences.english: I am a bit tired from the long drive.
sentences.chinese: 坐了这么长时间的车，我有点累了。

sentences.english: Please put your empty suitcase in the closet.
sentences.chinese: 请把空行李箱放进衣柜里。

conversation_script.text_en: East or west, home is best! We are finally back.
conversation_script.text_zh: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝！我们终于回来了。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I missed my own bed so much.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我太想念我自己的床了。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. Let's finish unpacking before we rest.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。我们先收拾完行李再休息吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. Should I separate the laundry?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。需要我把要洗的衣服分出来吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, please. Clean clothes go into the drawer, dirty ones go to the washing machine.
conversation_script.text_zh: 对，麻烦了。干净的放进抽屉，脏的拿到洗衣机那里。

conversation_script.text_en: Got it. Look, I found the shell we picked up at the beach!
conversation_script.text_zh: 明白。看，我找到了我们在海滩上捡的贝壳！

conversation_script.text_en: Beautiful! Let's put it on the living room shelf.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真漂亮！我们把它放在客厅的架子上吧。

lessons.description: Talking about limits on screen time, bedtimes, and keeping household harmony.

vocabulary.chinese: 屏幕时间/看电子产品时间

sentences.english: We need to follow our family rules.
sentences.chinese: 我们要遵守我们的家规。

sentences.english: Do we have an agreement on this?
sentences.chinese: 我们在这件事上达成一致了吗？

sentences.english: Your screen time is over for today.
sentences.chinese: 你今天的屏幕时间已经到了。

sentences.english: Please finish your homework before playing.
It's almost bedtime, turn off the light.
sentences.chinese: 快到睡觉时间了，把灯关掉。

sentences.english: I promise to speak politely.

conversation_script.text_en: Can I watch a video on the tablet now?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我现在可以用平板看视频吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Did you finish your school homework first?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你先做完学校的作业了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I finished everything. I promise!
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，全都做完了。我保证！

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. Remember our agreement: only thirty minutes of screen time.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好吧。记住我们的约定：只能看三十分钟屏幕。

conversation_script.text_en: That is fair. Can you set a timer for me?
conversation_script.text_zh: 这很公平。你能帮我定个闹钟吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. When the timer rings, you need to turn it off immediately.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没问题。闹钟响的时候，你必须马上把它关掉。

conversation_script.text_en: I know. I will follow the rule.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我知道。我会遵守规则的。

lessons.description: Doing extra chores to save money and learning about earning and budgeting.

sentences.english: How can I earn some pocket money?
sentences.chinese: 我怎么才能赚点零花钱？

sentences.english: You can do extra chores on the weekend.
sentences.chinese: 你可以在周末做些额外的家务活。

sentences.english: I want to save money for a new comic book.
sentences.chinese: 我想攒钱买一本新漫画书。

sentences.english: Put your coins into the piggy bank.
sentences.chinese: 把你的硬币放进储蓄罐里。

sentences.english: That toy is too expensive right now.
Don't spend all your allowance at once.
sentences.chinese: 别一次把你的零花钱全花光了。

conversation_script.text_en: I really want to buy this toy car, but I don't have enough money.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我真的很想买这辆玩具车，但我钱不够。

conversation_script.text_en: Would you like to earn some extra pocket money this week?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你这周想赚点额外的零花钱吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, please! What can I do to help?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太想了！我能做点什么来帮忙？

conversation_script.text_en: If you wash the family car with me, I will give you five dollars.
conversation_script.text_zh: 如果你跟我一起洗家里的车，我会给你五美元。

conversation_script.text_en: Awesome! I will do a great job.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！我会做得很好的。

conversation_script.text_en: Then you can put that money away to save up.
conversation_script.text_zh: 然后你就可以把这笔钱存起来了。

conversation_script.text_en: Perfect. It will go straight into my piggy bank!
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。它会直接进我的储蓄罐！

lessons.description: Sitting down together to talk about family plans, share news, and solve problems.

sentences.english: Let's hold a short family meeting.
sentences.chinese: 我们开个简短的家庭会议吧。

sentences.english: Everyone has a chance to speak.
Please listen carefully to her idea.
That is a very good suggestion.
sentences.chinese: 那是一个非常好的建议。

sentences.english: How should we solve this problem?
sentences.chinese: 我们该怎么解决这个问题？

sentences.english: We need to plan our weekend activities.
sentences.chinese: 我们需要计划一下周末的活动。

conversation_script.text_en: It's time for our weekly family meeting. Everyone come sit down.
conversation_script.text_zh: 到我们每周的家庭会议时间了。大家快来坐下。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay! What are we talking about today?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！我们今天聊点什么？

conversation_script.text_en: We need to plan our summer vacation. Any ideas?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们要计划一下暑假。有什么想法吗？

conversation_script.text_en: I want to go to the beach and swim!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想去海滩游泳！

conversation_script.text_en: That sounds fun. Let's see what the others think.
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来很好玩。我们看看其他人怎么想。

conversation_script.text_en: Can we vote on the best place to go?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们可以投票决定去最好的地方吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, voting is a great way to decide together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 可以，投票是一起做决定的好方法。

lessons.description: Traveling together by car, playing travel games, and enjoying the journey.

sentences.english: Please fastene your seatbelt before we start.
Look at the beautiful mountains outside the window.
Are we there yet?
We will stop at the next rest stop for a break.
sentences.chinese: 我们会在下一个服务区停下来休息一下。

sentences.english: Can you pass me the snacks from the bag?
sentences.chinese: 你能把包里的零食递给我吗？

sentences.english: Let's play a word game to pass the time.
sentences.chinese: 我们玩个文字游戏来打发时间吧。

conversation_script.text_en: How much longer until we arrive at the hotel?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们还要多久才能到酒店？

conversation_script.text_en: About two more hours. Are you feeling bored?
conversation_script.text_zh: 大概还要两个小时。你觉得无聊了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: A little bit. Can we listen to some music?
conversation_script.text_zh: 有一点点。我们可以听点音乐吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure, pick your favorite playlist. Also, look out the window!
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然可以，选你最喜欢的歌单吧。还有，看看窗外！

conversation_script.text_en: Wow, those horses are so cool! Where are they going?
conversation_script.text_zh: 哇，那些马好酷啊！它们要去哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: They live on that farm. Road trips are great for seeing new things.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它们住在那个农场里。自驾游最适合看新事物了。

conversation_script.text_en: You're right. Time is going faster now.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你说的对。现在感觉时间过得快多了。

lessons.description: Encouraging each other for daily achievements, progress, and good efforts.

sentences.english: I am so proud of your hard work.
sentences.chinese: 我真为你付出的努力感到骄傲。

sentences.english: You made great progress today!
sentences.chinese: 你今天取得了很大的进步！

sentences.english: Let's celebrate your small win.
sentences.chinese: 我们来庆祝一下你的小小成功吧。

sentences.english: Give me a high five!
Your English is improving every day.
sentences.chinese: 你的英语每天都在进步。

sentences.english: The most important thing is that you tried.
sentences.chinese: 最重要的是你努力尝试了。

conversation_script.text_en: Guess what? I finally finished reading the whole book by myself!
conversation_script.text_zh: 你猜怎么着？我终于自己把整本书读完了！

conversation_script.text_en: Wow, that's awesome! Give me a high five.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哇，太棒了！跟我击个掌。

conversation_script.text_en: It was hard at first, but I didn't give up.
conversation_script.text_zh: 刚开始挺难的，但我没有放弃。

conversation_script.text_en: I know. I saw you practicing every single evening.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我知道。我看到你每天晚上都在练习。

conversation_script.text_en: Should we celebrate with some ice cream tonight?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们今晚吃点冰激凌庆祝一下怎么样？

conversation_script.text_en: Definitely! You earned a special treat for your great effort.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那必须的！你付出了这么大努力，应该得到特别奖励。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you! Let's go get some.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢！我们去吃吧。

lessons.description: Saying sorry sincerely after making a mistake or hurt feelings.

sentences.english: I am really sorry for what I said.
sentences.chinese: 我对我刚才说的话感到非常抱歉。

sentences.english: It was an accident, I didn't mean to do it.
sentences.chinese: 那是个意外，我不是故意的。

sentences.english: Will you forgive me, please?
I will be more careful next time.
It is okay, don't worry about it.
Let's have a hug and make up.

conversation_script.text_en: Hey, I want to say sorry. I broke your favorite toy.
conversation_script.text_zh: 嘿，我想跟你说声对不起。我把你最喜欢的玩具弄坏了。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh no! How did that happen? I am very sad.
conversation_script.text_zh: 糟糕！怎么会这样？我很难过。

conversation_script.text_en: I dropped it by accident. I didn't mean to break it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我不小心掉地上了。我不是故意弄坏的。

conversation_script.text_en: It was a gift from Grandma. Please be more careful with my things.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那是奶奶送的礼物。以后请对我的东西小心一点。

conversation_script.text_en: I promise I will. Can we try to fix it together?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我保证会注意的。我们能试着一起把它修好吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, let's look for some glue. Thank you for apologizing.
conversation_script.text_zh: 行吧，我们去找点胶水。谢谢你向我道歉。

conversation_script.text_en: Of course. I want us to be happy.
conversation_script.text_zh: 应该的。我希望我们开开心心的。

lessons.description: Morning routines right before leaving the house, wishing a good day, and saying goodbye.

sentences.english: Have a wonderful day at school!
sentences.chinese: 在学校度过美好的一天！

sentences.english: Do you have your lunchbox in your backpack?
sentences.chinese: 你的午餐盒放进书包了吗？

sentences.english: The school bus is coming now.
Give me a kiss before you go.
Learn something new today!
See you later in the afternoon.

conversation_script.text_en: Hurry up, sweetie! It's almost time to leave for school.
conversation_script.text_zh: 快点，宝贝！差不多该去学校了。

conversation_script.text_en: I am putting my water bottle in my bag now. I'm ready!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我正在把水杯放进包里。我准备好了！

conversation_script.text_en: Great. Do you have your homework project safely packed?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。你的作业项目好好装进去了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, it is right here. Don't worry.
conversation_script.text_zh: 装好了，就在这儿。别担心。

conversation_script.text_en: Good. Have fun, listen to your teacher, and be kind.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那就好。玩得开心，听老师的话，对人要有礼貌。

conversation_script.text_en: I will! Goodbye, see you after school!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我会的！再见，放学后见！

conversation_script.text_en: Goodbye! I love you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 再见！我爱你。

lessons.description: Greeting a family member returning home after a long workday.

sentences.english: Welcome home, Dad!
How was your day at work?
Here are your comfortable slippers.
Can I hang up your coat for you?
sentences.chinese: 我可以帮您把外套挂起来吗？

sentences.english: You look a little tired tonight.
Sit down on the sofa and take a rest.
sentences.chinese: 坐在沙发上休息一会儿吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Daddy's home! Welcome back!
conversation_script.text_zh: 爸爸回来了！欢迎回来！

conversation_script.text_en: Hi there! Oh, it's so good to see you. Give me a big hug.
conversation_script.text_zh: 嗨！噢，见到你真高兴。快给我一个大大的拥抱。

conversation_script.text_en: Here are your slippers. Was the traffic bad today?
conversation_script.text_zh: 给您拖鞋。今天路上堵车厉害吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you. Yes, the traffic was terrible, and work was very busy.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢。是的，交通太糟糕了，工作也很忙。

conversation_script.text_en: Go sit down on the sofa. Dinner is almost ready.
conversation_script.text_zh: 快去沙发上坐着吧。晚饭马上就好啦。

conversation_script.text_en: That sounds amazing. Thank you for being so thoughtful.
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来太棒了。谢谢你这么贴心。

conversation_script.text_en: You're welcome! I am just happy you are home.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不客气！你回到家我就很开心啦。

lessons.description: Talking about reading books and enjoying quiet family time.

sentences.english: Let's read a book together.
I love this story.
Can you turn the page?
Look at this picture.
It's nice and quiet here.
This is my favorite book.
Let's finish this chapter.
Reading helps me relax.

conversation_script.text_en: It's so quiet now. Do you want to read a book?
conversation_script.text_zh: 现在好安静。你想读书吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, I love reading with you! Which book should we pick?
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，我喜欢和你一起读书！我们应该选哪本书？

conversation_script.text_en: How about this one? It has lots of pictures.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这本怎么样？它有很多图片。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! Can you read the first page?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！你能读第一页吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit...
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。从前，有一只小兔子……

conversation_script.text_en: I like this story. Can we read another chapter?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢这个故事。我们能再读一章吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course. But first, let's look at the pictures on this page.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然可以。不过首先，让我们看看这页上的图片。

conversation_script.text_en: The rabbit is so cute! This is my favorite page.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这只兔子好可爱！这是我最喜欢的一页。

conversation_script.text_en: Mine too. Reading together is the best way to relax.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。一起读书是最好的放松方式。

lessons.description: Talking about exercising and staying active as a family.

sentences.english: Let's do some exercise together.
I need to stretch first.
Running makes me feel good.
Don't forget to warm up.
Take a deep breath.
Exercise keeps us healthy.
I feel a little tired.
Let's cool down and drink water.
sentences.chinese: 让我们放松下来喝点水。

sentences.english: Jumping is fun!
Walking after dinner is nice.

conversation_script.text_en: Hey, it's family exercise time! Are you ready?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嘿，家庭运动时间到了！你准备好了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, but I need to warm up first. My muscles feel tight.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，但我需要先热身。我的肌肉感觉很紧。

conversation_script.text_en: Good idea. Let's stretch our arms and legs.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好主意。让我们伸展一下手臂和腿。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. Now, should we run in place or go outside?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。现在，我们应该原地跑步还是出去跑？

conversation_script.text_en: Let's go outside. Fresh air is better for exercise.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们出去吧。新鲜空气对运动更好。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! I'll race you to the corner.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！我和你比赛跑到拐角处。

conversation_script.text_en: Slow down! Remember to take deep breaths.
conversation_script.text_zh: 慢点！记得深呼吸。

conversation_script.text_en: I'm a little tired now. Can we walk back?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我现在有点累了。我们能走回去吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. Walking is good exercise too. Let's cool down.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。走路也是很好的运动。让我们放松下来。

conversation_script.text_en: That was fun! I feel strong and healthy.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真有趣！我感觉强壮又健康。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. Let's do this again tomorrow!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。我们明天再做一次吧！

lessons.description: Talking about decorating rooms and making the home look nice.

sentences.english: Let's decorate the living room.
What color should we paint the wall?
sentences.chinese: 我们应该把墙漆成什么颜色？

sentences.english: I want to hang this picture here.
sentences.chinese: 我想把这幅画挂在这里。

sentences.english: This plant looks nice on the shelf.
sentences.chinese: 这盆植物放在架子上很好看。

sentences.english: The room looks beautiful now.
sentences.chinese: 房间现在看起来很漂亮。

sentences.english: Can you help me move the lamp?
sentences.chinese: 你能帮我移动一下灯吗？

sentences.english: Let's keep the house tidy.
I like how you decorated your room.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢你装饰房间的方式。

conversation_script.text_en: The weekend is here! Let's decorate the house together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 周末到了！我们一起装饰房子吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Sounds fun! Which room should we start with?
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来很有趣！我们应该从哪个房间开始？

conversation_script.text_en: Let's start with the living room. We can hang some new pictures on the wall.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们从客厅开始吧。我们可以在墙上挂一些新画。

conversation_script.text_en: Good idea. What color do you want to paint this wall?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好主意。你想把这面墙漆成什么颜色？

conversation_script.text_en: How about light blue? It looks calm and beautiful.
conversation_script.text_zh: 浅蓝色怎么样？它看起来宁静又漂亮。

conversation_script.text_en: I like that. Can I put this plant on the shelf?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢。我能把这盆植物放在架子上吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! And let's move the lamp next to the sofa.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！让我们把灯移到沙发旁边。

conversation_script.text_en: The room looks so different now. It's really beautiful!
conversation_script.text_zh: 房间现在看起来很不一样了。真的很漂亮！

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, decorating together is so much fun. Let's do my room next!
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，一起装饰太有趣了。接下来做我的房间吧！

lessons.description: Talking about helping and looking after younger brothers or sisters.

sentences.english: Can you help me take care of my sister?
sentences.chinese: 你能帮我照顾一下我妹妹吗？

sentences.english: Be gentle with the baby.
She needs her bottle now.
Let's share our toys.
The baby is crying. What should we do?
sentences.chinese: 宝宝在哭。我们该怎么办？

sentences.english: It's time for her nap.
You are a good big brother.
I will hold her hand.
Taking care of siblings is important.
You are very responsible.

conversation_script.text_en: Mom is busy in the kitchen. Can you help me watch your little sister?
conversation_script.text_zh: 妈妈在厨房忙。你能帮我看着妹妹吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! What should I do first?
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！我应该先做什么？

conversation_script.text_en: She might be hungry. Can you get her bottle?
conversation_script.text_zh: 她可能饿了。你能拿她的奶瓶吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, here is the bottle. Should I hold her?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，奶瓶在这里。我应该抱着她吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, but be gentle. She is very small.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，但要温柔。她还很小。

conversation_script.text_en: I will be careful. Oh no, she is crying!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我会小心的。哦不，她在哭！

conversation_script.text_en: Maybe she is tired. It's time for her nap.
conversation_script.text_zh: 也许她累了。她该小睡了。

conversation_script.text_en: Should I sing a song to help her sleep?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我应该唱首歌帮她入睡吗？

conversation_script.text_en: That would be nice. You are such a good helper.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那太好了。你真是个好孩子。

conversation_script.text_en: I like taking care of her. It makes me feel responsible.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢照顾她。这让我感到有责任心。

conversation_script.text_en: You are a wonderful big brother. She is lucky to have you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你是个很棒的哥哥。她很幸运有你。

lessons.description: Talking about special family customs and traditions that bring everyone together.

sentences.english: Our family has a special tradition.
sentences.chinese: 我们家有一个特别的传统。

sentences.english: We always celebrate holidays together.
sentences.chinese: 我们总是一起庆祝节日。

sentences.english: Grandma's recipe is passed down to us.
sentences.chinese: 奶奶的食谱传给了我们。

sentences.english: This ritual makes me feel close to my family.
sentences.chinese: 这个仪式让我感到和家人很亲近。

sentences.english: We gather for dinner every Sunday.
sentences.chinese: 我们每个周日聚在一起吃晚饭。

sentences.english: These memories are very special to me.
sentences.chinese: 这些回忆对我来说非常特别。

sentences.english: I want to pass down this custom to my children.
sentences.chinese: 我想把这个习俗传给我的孩子。

sentences.english: Family togetherness is important.
This is a meaningful tradition.
sentences.chinese: 这是一个有意义的传统。

sentences.english: Let's start a new family ritual.
sentences.chinese: 让我们开始一个新的家庭仪式吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Do you know why we always eat dumplings on New Year's Eve?
conversation_script.text_zh: 你知道为什么我们总是在除夕吃饺子吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Because it's our family tradition, right?
conversation_script.text_zh: 因为这是我们的家庭传统，对吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Exactly! Grandma passed down this recipe to Mom, and Mom taught me.
conversation_script.text_zh: 没错！奶奶把这个食谱传给了妈妈，妈妈又教了我。

conversation_script.text_en: I love this ritual. It makes the holiday feel special.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢这个仪式。它让节日感觉很特别。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. And every Sunday, we gather for a big family dinner.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。而且每个周日，我们都会聚在一起吃家庭晚餐。

conversation_script.text_en: Those are my favorite memories. Everyone laughs and shares stories.
conversation_script.text_zh: 那些是我最喜欢的回忆。每个人都笑着分享故事。

conversation_script.text_en: Family togetherness is what makes these traditions meaningful.
conversation_script.text_zh: 家庭团聚让这些传统变得有意义。

conversation_script.text_en: I hope we can pass down these customs to the next generation.
conversation_script.text_zh: 希望我们能把这些习俗传给下一代。

conversation_script.text_en: We will. Maybe we can even start a new tradition this year.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们会的。也许今年我们甚至可以开始一个新的传统。

conversation_script.text_en: Like what? A family game night every month?
conversation_script.text_zh: 比如什么？每个月一次的家庭游戏之夜？

conversation_script.text_en: That sounds perfect! Let's do it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来太棒了！就这么做吧。

lessons.description: Talking about daily activities, sharing experiences, and catching up with family members.

sentences.english: How was your day?
I had a busy morning.
Tell me about your day.
Something fun happened at school.
I am a little tired.
Let's share our stories.
sentences.chinese: 让我们分享我们的故事吧。

sentences.english: What did you do this afternoon?
Work was good today.
I want to hear about your evening.
Talking about our day brings us closer.
sentences.chinese: 谈论我们的一天让我们更亲近。

conversation_script.text_en: Hey, you're home! How was your day?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嘿，你回来了！你今天过得怎么样？

conversation_script.text_en: It was okay. I had a busy morning at work.
conversation_script.text_zh: 还可以。我早上工作很忙。

conversation_script.text_en: Tell me about it. What happened?
conversation_script.text_zh: 告诉我吧。发生了什么事？

conversation_script.text_en: We had a big meeting. It was long but useful.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们开了一个大会。时间很长但很有用。

conversation_script.text_en: Sounds tiring. What about your afternoon?
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来很累。那下午呢？

conversation_script.text_en: I went to the gym. It felt good to move around.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我去了健身房。活动一下感觉很舒服。

conversation_script.text_en: Nice! I had a fun day too. I met an old friend for lunch.
conversation_script.text_zh: 不错！我今天也过得很开心。我和一个老朋友吃了午饭。

conversation_script.text_en: That's great! What did you talk about?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！你们聊了什么？

conversation_script.text_en: We shared memories from school. It was really nice.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们分享了学校时的回忆。真的很开心。

conversation_script.text_en: I love when we talk about our days. It makes me feel close to you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢我们谈论各自的一天。这让我感觉和你很亲近。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. Let's do this every evening!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。让我们每天晚上都这样做吧！

lessons.description: Talking about working together on a building or craft project as a family.

sentences.english: Let's build something together.
sentences.chinese: 我们一起建造点东西吧。

sentences.english: Do you have the right tools?
We need to measure the wood first.
Teamwork makes the project easier.
sentences.chinese: 团队合作让项目更容易。

sentences.english: Can you hand me the hammer?
This nail is too long.
Let's follow the plan step by step.
sentences.chinese: 让我们一步一步按照计划来。

sentences.english: We need to fix this part.
The project is almost finished.
I am proud of what we built.
sentences.chinese: 我为我们建造的东西感到骄傲。

conversation_script.text_en: I have an idea! Let's build a small bookshelf this weekend.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有个主意！这个周末我们建一个小书架吧。

conversation_script.text_en: That sounds fun! Do we have all the tools we need?
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来很有趣！我们有所有需要的工具吗？

conversation_script.text_en: I have a hammer and some nails. We just need to buy the wood.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有锤子和一些钉子。我们只需要买木头。

conversation_script.text_en: Great. Should we make a plan first?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了。我们应该先做个计划吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, let's measure the space where we want to put it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，让我们测量一下我们想放书架的地方。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, I will hold the measuring tape. You check the numbers.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我来拿卷尺。你看数字。

conversation_script.text_en: Perfect. Now let's cut the wood and start building.
conversation_script.text_zh: 完美。现在让我们切木头开始建造吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you hand me the hammer? I need to put in a nail.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你能把锤子递给我吗？我需要钉一个钉子。

conversation_script.text_en: Here you go. Be careful with your fingers!
conversation_script.text_zh: 给你。小心你的手指！

conversation_script.text_en: Thanks. This is hard work, but I love doing it together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢。这工作很辛苦，但我喜欢一起做。

conversation_script.text_en: Teamwork makes it fun. Look, the bookshelf is finished!
conversation_script.text_zh: 团队合作让它变得有趣。看，书架完成了！

conversation_script.text_en: Wow, it looks amazing! I am so proud of us.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哇，看起来太棒了！我为我们感到骄傲。

lessons.description: Talking about baking cookies and enjoying sweet treats as a family.

sentences.english: Let's bake some cookies together.
We need flour, sugar, and butter.
sentences.chinese: 我们需要面粉、糖和黄油。

sentences.english: Can you mix the ingredients?
sentences.chinese: 你能把材料混合一下吗？

sentences.english: The dough feels soft and smooth.
sentences.chinese: 面团摸起来又软又光滑。

sentences.english: Let's shape the cookies into hearts.
sentences.chinese: 让我们把饼干做成心形。

sentences.english: The oven is hot. Be careful!
They smell so good!
This recipe is really easy.
The cookies are golden brown.
They taste delicious!

conversation_script.text_en: I feel like baking today. Want to make cookies with me?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我今天想烘焙。想和我一起做饼干吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! I love baking. Do we have all the ingredients?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！我喜欢烘焙。我们有所有材料吗？

conversation_script.text_en: We have flour, sugar, and butter. We just need some eggs.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们有面粉、糖和黄油。我们只需要一些鸡蛋。

conversation_script.text_en: I can get the eggs from the fridge. What's next?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我可以从冰箱里拿鸡蛋。接下来做什么？

conversation_script.text_en: First, mix the flour and sugar in a big bowl.
conversation_script.text_zh: 首先，把面粉和糖放在一个大碗里混合。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, I will mix it. The dough is getting soft!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我来混合。面团变软了！

conversation_script.text_en: Great! Now let's shape the cookies. What shape do you want?
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！现在让我们做饼干的形状。你想要什么形状？

conversation_script.text_en: Can we make stars and hearts? Those are my favorites.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们能做星星和心形吗？那些是我的最爱。

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! Now let's put them in the oven. It will take ten minutes.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！现在让我们把它们放进烤箱。需要十分钟。

conversation_script.text_en: I can't wait! They already smell so good.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我等不及了！它们已经闻起来很香了。

conversation_script.text_en: Look, they are golden brown. Let's take them out.
conversation_script.text_zh: 看，它们是金棕色的。让我们把它们拿出来。

conversation_script.text_en: They taste amazing! Baking together is the best.
conversation_script.text_zh: 它们尝起来太棒了！一起烘焙是最好的。

lessons.description: Talking about creating a scrapbook with family photos and memories.

sentences.english: Let's make a family scrapbook.
sentences.chinese: 让我们做一本家庭剪贴簿吧。

sentences.english: We need old photos and some glue.
sentences.chinese: 我们需要旧照片和一些胶水。

sentences.english: This photo brings back so many memories.
sentences.chinese: 这张照片让我想起了很多回忆。

sentences.english: Can you cut the photo with scissors?
Let's put a sticker on this page.
sentences.chinese: 让我们在这页上贴一个贴纸。

sentences.english: I love decorating the pages.
This is a special memory for our family.
sentences.chinese: 这对我们家来说是一个特别的回忆。

sentences.english: We can collect more photos for the next page.
sentences.chinese: 我们可以收集更多照片做下一页。

sentences.english: This scrapbook is a treasure.
sentences.chinese: 这本剪贴簿是一个珍藏。

sentences.english: You are so creative!

conversation_script.text_en: I found a box of old family photos. Want to make a scrapbook?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我找到了一盒旧家庭照片。想做一本剪贴簿吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! That sounds like a wonderful idea. Where do we start?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！这听起来是个很棒的主意。我们从哪里开始？

conversation_script.text_en: First, let's pick our favorite photos. This one is from our trip to the beach.
conversation_script.text_zh: 首先，让我们挑选最喜欢的照片。这张是我们去海滩旅行的。

conversation_script.text_en: I remember that day! The water was so blue. Can I glue this photo on the first page?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我记得那天！海水很蓝。我能把这张照片贴在第一页吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course. Then we can add some stickers and write the date.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。然后我们可以加一些贴纸并写上日期。

conversation_script.text_en: I have some star stickers. They will look cute around the photo.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有一些星星贴纸。它们放在照片周围会很好看。

conversation_script.text_en: Great idea! Now let's do a page for grandma's birthday party.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好主意！现在让我们做一页奶奶生日派对的。

conversation_script.text_en: I love this photo of her blowing out the candles. It's so special.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢这张她吹蜡烛的照片。太特别了。

conversation_script.text_en: Every page tells a story. This scrapbook will be a family treasure.
conversation_script.text_zh: 每一页都讲述一个故事。这本剪贴簿将成为家庭珍藏。

conversation_script.text_en: I agree. Let's keep collecting photos and make more pages together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我同意。让我们继续收集照片，一起做更多页面。

lessons.description: Talking about deciding on a pet and taking care of it as a family.

sentences.english: Can we get a family pet?
sentences.chinese: 我们能养一只家庭宠物吗？

sentences.english: What kind of pet do you want?
I think a dog would be great.
Cats are easier to take care of.
We need to feed it every day.
Who will walk the dog?
A pet is a big responsibility.
sentences.chinese: 宠物是一个很大的责任。

sentences.english: Let's visit the animal shelter to adopt one.
sentences.chinese: 让我们去动物收容所领养一只吧。

sentences.english: It looks so cute and friendly!
sentences.chinese: 它看起来又可爱又友好！

sentences.english: We need to give it training.

conversation_script.text_en: I have been thinking... can we get a family pet?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我一直在想……我们能养一只家庭宠物吗？

conversation_script.text_en: That's a big decision. What kind of pet do you want?
conversation_script.text_zh: 这是一个重大的决定。你想要什么样的宠物？

conversation_script.text_en: I really want a dog. They are friendly and fun to play with.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我真的很想要一只狗。它们很友好，玩起来很有趣。

conversation_script.text_en: Dogs need a lot of care. Who will walk it every morning?
conversation_script.text_zh: 狗需要很多照顾。谁每天早上遛狗？

conversation_script.text_en: I can do it! And I will help feed it too.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我可以做！而且我也会帮忙喂它。

conversation_script.text_en: A pet is a big responsibility for the whole family.
conversation_script.text_zh: 宠物对整个家庭来说是一个很大的责任。

conversation_script.text_en: I know. But I promise to take good care of it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我知道。但我保证会好好照顾它。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, let's visit the animal shelter this weekend. We can adopt one.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，这个周末我们去动物收容所吧。我们可以领养一只。

conversation_script.text_en: Really? Thank you! I can't wait to meet our new friend.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？谢谢你！我等不及要见我们的新朋友了。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. Let's choose one that is cute and friendly.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。让我们选一只又可爱又友好的。

conversation_script.text_en: And we will give it lots of love and training. It will be part of our family!
conversation_script.text_zh: 而且我们会给它很多爱和训练。它将成为我们家庭的一员！

lessons.description: Talking about moving houses, packing belongings, and settling into a new place.

sentences.english: We are moving to a new home.
Let's pack our things in boxes.
sentences.chinese: 让我们把东西打包进箱子里。

sentences.english: This box is very heavy.
Don't forget to label the boxes.
I am excited about our new house.
sentences.chinese: 我对我们的新房子很兴奋。

sentences.english: Moving is hard work.
Let's unpack the kitchen first.
sentences.chinese: 让我们先拆厨房的东西。

sentences.english: The neighborhood looks nice.
sentences.chinese: 这个 neighborhood 看起来不错。

sentences.english: I feel tired but happy.
We will settle in soon.
sentences.chinese: 我们很快会安顿下来的。

conversation_script.text_en: Big news! We are moving to a new home next month.
conversation_script.text_zh: 大消息！我们下个月要搬到新家了。

conversation_script.text_en: Really? I am excited but also a little nervous.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？我很兴奋但也有点紧张。

conversation_script.text_en: It's normal to feel that way. Let's start packing our things.
conversation_script.text_zh: 有这种感觉是正常的。让我们开始打包东西吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. Should I pack my books first?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。我应该先打包我的书吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, and put them in a small box. Books are heavy.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，把它们放在一个小箱子里。书很重。

conversation_script.text_en: I will label the box 'books' so we can find it easily.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我会给箱子贴上'书'的标签，这样我们能很容易找到。

conversation_script.text_en: Good thinking. The moving truck will come on Saturday morning.
conversation_script.text_zh: 想得好。搬家卡车星期六早上来。

conversation_script.text_en: What about our furniture?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们的家具怎么办？

conversation_script.text_en: The movers will help us. We just need to pack the small things.
conversation_script.text_zh: 搬家工人会帮我们。我们只需要打包小东西。

conversation_script.text_en: I can't wait to see our new room. Is the neighborhood nice?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我等不及要看我们的新房间了。 neighborhood 好吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Very nice! There is a park nearby. You will love it.
conversation_script.text_zh: 非常好！附近有一个公园。你会喜欢的。

conversation_script.text_en: This is a new adventure for our family. I feel happy!
conversation_script.text_zh: 这对我们家来说是一次新的冒险。我感到开心！

lessons.description: Talking about visiting family members, traveling, and spending time with relatives.

sentences.english: We are going to visit our relatives.
It's a long trip by car.
sentences.chinese: 开车是一段很长的旅程。

sentences.english: I bought a gift for my aunt.
sentences.chinese: 我给阿姨买了一份礼物。

sentences.english: My cousin is very friendly.
sentences.chinese: 我的堂兄弟姐妹很友好。

sentences.english: Give grandma a big hug.
sentences.chinese: 给奶奶一个大大的拥抱。

sentences.english: We have a lot to catch up on.
It's been a long time since we last met.
sentences.chinese: 我们上次见面已经很久了。

sentences.english: They welcomed us warmly.
Traveling to see family is always worth it.
sentences.chinese: 旅行去看家人总是值得的。

sentences.english: I love visiting my uncle's house.

conversation_script.text_en: Are you ready for our trip? We are visiting grandma this weekend.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你准备好旅行了吗？这个周末我们要去看奶奶。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! I haven't seen her in a long time. I miss her.
conversation_script.text_zh: 准备好了！我很久没见她了。我想她。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. I bought her some flowers as a gift.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。我给她买了一些花作为礼物。

conversation_script.text_en: That's sweet. What about uncle and aunt? Are they coming too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 真贴心。叔叔和阿姨呢？他们也会来吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, the whole family will be there. Even my cousin from the city.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，全家人都会来。甚至我在城里的堂兄弟姐妹也会来。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! I love when we all get together. It's so much fun.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！我喜欢我们聚在一起。太有趣了。

conversation_script.text_en: The car ride is about three hours. Bring a book or some music.
conversation_script.text_zh: 车程大约三小时。带本书或一些音乐。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay. I will also bring some snacks for the trip.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的。我还会带一些零食路上吃。

conversation_script.text_en: Perfect. When we arrive, give everyone a big hug.
conversation_script.text_zh: 完美。当我们到达时，给每个人一个大大的拥抱。

conversation_script.text_en: Of course! I can't wait to catch up with everyone.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！我等不及要和每个人叙旧了。

conversation_script.text_en: Family visits are the best. Let's hit the road!
conversation_script.text_zh: 家庭拜访是最好的。我们上路吧！

lessons.description: Talking about welcoming visitors, preparing the house, and entertaining guests.

sentences.english: We have guests coming today.
Let's tidy up the living room.
Please make yourself comfortable.
Can I offer you a drink?
We prepared some snacks for you.
sentences.chinese: 我们为你准备了一些零食。

sentences.english: Thank you for visiting us.
I hope you enjoy your stay.
sentences.chinese: 希望你在这里过得愉快。

sentences.english: It's polite to offer guests something to eat.
sentences.chinese: 给客人提供吃的很有礼貌。

sentences.english: The house looks clean and welcoming.
sentences.chinese: 房子看起来干净又温馨。

sentences.english: Hosting guests makes me happy.

conversation_script.text_en: Our friends are coming over at six. Let's get the house ready.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们的朋友六点要来。让我们把房子准备好。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, I will tidy the living room and put out some cushions.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我会整理客厅并放一些靠垫。

conversation_script.text_en: Good idea. I will prepare some snacks and drinks in the kitchen.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好主意。我会在厨房准备一些零食和饮料。

conversation_script.text_en: Should I set the table too?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也应该摆桌子吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, please. And make sure the bathroom is clean.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，请摆一下。还要确保浴室干净。

conversation_script.text_en: Done! The house looks welcoming now.
conversation_script.text_zh: 完成了！房子现在看起来很温馨。

conversation_script.text_en: The doorbell! They are here. Welcome, please come in!
conversation_script.text_zh: 门铃响了！他们来了。欢迎，请进！

conversation_script.text_en: Please make yourself comfortable. Can I offer you some tea?
conversation_script.text_zh: 请随意，别拘束。我能给你倒杯茶吗？

conversation_script.text_en: We have some homemade cookies too. Help yourselves!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们还有一些自制饼干。请随意！

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you for having us. Your home is so lovely.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢你们的招待。你们家真温馨。

conversation_script.text_en: We are happy you came. Let's enjoy the evening together!
conversation_script.text_zh: 很高兴你们来了。让我们一起享受这个晚上吧！

lessons.description: Talking about preparing snacks and enjoying a movie night together as a family.

sentences.english: It's family movie night!
Let's make some popcorn.
sentences.chinese: 让我们做一些爆米花吧。

sentences.english: What movie should we watch?
Get a blanket and a pillow.
sentences.chinese: 拿一条毯子和一个枕头。

sentences.english: This couch is so comfy.
Pass me the snacks, please.
This movie is so funny!
I love laughing together.
Movie nights help me relax.
Spending time together is the best part.
sentences.chinese: 一起度过时光是最棒的部分。

conversation_script.text_en: Guess what? It's Friday — family movie night!
conversation_script.text_zh: 你猜怎么着？今天是星期五——家庭电影之夜！

conversation_script.text_en: Yay! I have been waiting all week. What movie are we watching?
conversation_script.text_zh: 耶！我等了一整周了。我们要看什么电影？

conversation_script.text_en: You can choose tonight. Do you want comedy or adventure?
conversation_script.text_zh: 今晚你来选。你想要喜剧还是冒险片？

conversation_script.text_en: Comedy! I want to laugh a lot. Let's pick a funny one.
conversation_script.text_zh: 喜剧！我想大笑一场。让我们选一部搞笑的。

conversation_script.text_en: Great choice. Now, let's make some popcorn and get drinks.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好选择。现在，让我们做一些爆米花并拿饮料。

conversation_script.text_en: I will get the popcorn. Can you grab some juice from the fridge?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我来做爆米花。你能从冰箱里拿点果汁吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure. And don't forget the blanket. It gets cold at night.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。别忘了毯子。晚上会变冷。

conversation_script.text_en: I already have my favorite pillow. This couch is so comfy!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我已经拿了我最喜欢的枕头。这张沙发真舒服！

conversation_script.text_en: The movie is starting. Pass me some popcorn, please!
conversation_script.text_zh: 电影开始了。请递给我一些爆米花！

conversation_script.text_en: Here you go. This movie is so funny! I can't stop laughing.
conversation_script.text_zh: 给你。这部电影太好笑了！我笑个不停。

conversation_script.text_en: I love these nights. Relaxing together is the best.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢这些夜晚。一起放松是最棒的。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. Let's do this every Friday!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。让我们每个星期五都这样做吧！

lessons.description: Talking about doing household chores and keeping the home clean as a team.

sentences.english: Let's clean the house together.
I will sweep the floor.
Can you mop the kitchen?
The living room needs dusting.
I will vacuum the carpet.
Doing chores is faster with teamwork.
sentences.chinese: 有团队合作做家务更快。

sentences.english: Don't forget to take out the trash.
The house looks shiny and clean.
sentences.chinese: 房子看起来又亮又干净。

sentences.english: I need a bucket of water.
Cleaning together is actually fun.

conversation_script.text_en: The house is a mess. Let's clean it together this Saturday morning.
conversation_script.text_zh: 房子一团糟。让我们星期六早上一起打扫吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay! I can sweep the floor. Where is the broom?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！我可以扫地。扫帚在哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: It's in the closet. I will mop the kitchen after you finish sweeping.
conversation_script.text_zh: 在壁橱里。你扫完后我会拖厨房。

conversation_script.text_en: Sounds good. Should I also dust the shelves?
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来不错。我也应该擦架子吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, please. And I will vacuum the living room carpet.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的，请擦。我会吸客厅的地毯。

conversation_script.text_en: Teamwork makes this so much faster. I like cleaning together!
conversation_script.text_zh: 团队合作让这快多了。我喜欢一起打扫！

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. Don't forget to tidy your room too.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。别忘了也整理你的房间。

conversation_script.text_en: I will. And I will take out the trash when we are done.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我会的。做完后我会去倒垃圾。

conversation_script.text_en: Great! Look at the floor now. It's so shiny!
conversation_script.text_zh: 太好了！看看现在的地板。真亮！

conversation_script.text_en: The house looks amazing. We did a great job!
conversation_script.text_zh: 房子看起来太棒了。我们做得很好！

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! Now we can relax in our clean home.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！现在我们可以在干净的家放松了。

lessons.description: Talking about moving furniture around and making the bedroom feel fresh and comfortable.

sentences.english: Let's rearrange the bedroom.
sentences.chinese: 让我们重新布置卧室吧。

sentences.english: Can you help me move the bed?
The desk looks better near the window.
sentences.chinese: 书桌放在窗户旁边更好看。

sentences.english: I need more space in my closet.
sentences.chinese: 我的衣柜需要更多空间。

sentences.english: Put the lamp on the nightstand.
This corner is perfect for reading.
The room feels fresh and new.
I want my bed to face the window.
This layout is more comfortable.
Rearranging makes the room feel bigger.
sentences.chinese: 重新布置让房间感觉更大。

conversation_script.text_en: I want to change my bedroom. Can we rearrange the furniture?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想改变一下卧室。我们能重新布置家具吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! Where do you want to move the bed?
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！你想把床移到哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: I want it near the window. I like waking up to sunlight.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想放在窗户旁边。我喜欢在阳光下醒来。

conversation_script.text_en: Good idea. And the desk can go in the corner by the closet.
conversation_script.text_zh: 好主意。书桌可以放在衣柜旁边的角落。

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! That will give me more space to walk around.
conversation_script.text_zh: 是的！那样会给我更多走动的空间。

conversation_script.text_en: Can you hold this side? We need to move the bed together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你能扶住这边吗？我们需要一起移动床。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, on three. One, two, three!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，数到三。一、二、三！

conversation_script.text_en: Perfect spot. Now let's put the lamp on the nightstand.
conversation_script.text_zh: 位置完美。现在把台灯放在床头柜上。

conversation_script.text_en: The room looks so different. It feels fresh and new!
conversation_script.text_zh: 房间看起来很不一样了。感觉焕然一新！

conversation_script.text_en: I agree. This layout is much more comfortable.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我同意。这种布局舒服多了。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you for helping me. I love my new room!
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢你帮我。我喜欢我的新房间！

lessons.description: Talking about repairing a broken toy and learning how things work.

sentences.english: My toy car is broken.
Can you help me fix it?
We need some glue for this part.
sentences.chinese: 这部分我们需要一些胶水。

sentences.english: The wheel came off.
Let's check the batteries.
This screw is loose.
Be careful with the screwdriver.
It works again!
Fixing things takes patience.
I learned how my toy works inside.
sentences.chinese: 我了解了玩具内部的运作。

conversation_script.text_en: Dad, my toy car stopped working. Can you help me fix it?
conversation_script.text_zh: 爸爸，我的玩具车不走了。你能帮我修理吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course! Let's see what's wrong. First, check the batteries.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！让我们看看哪里出了问题。首先，检查电池。

conversation_script.text_en: The batteries are new. But one wheel is loose.
conversation_script.text_zh: 电池是新的。但有一个轮子松了。

conversation_script.text_en: Ah, I see. The screw fell out. We need a screwdriver.
conversation_script.text_zh: 啊，我看到了。螺丝掉了。我们需要螺丝刀。

conversation_script.text_en: Here it is. Can I try?
conversation_script.text_zh: 在这里。我可以试试吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, but be careful. Turn it slowly and gently.
conversation_script.text_zh: 可以，但要小心。慢慢地轻轻地转。

conversation_script.text_en: I did it! The wheel is back on.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我做到了！轮子装回去了。

conversation_script.text_en: Great job. Now let's test it. Push the button.
conversation_script.text_zh: 做得好。现在让我们测试一下。按按钮。

conversation_script.text_en: It works! The car is moving again!
conversation_script.text_zh: 它动了！车又走了！

conversation_script.text_en: You fixed it yourself. Fixing things takes patience and practice.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你自己修好了。修理东西需要耐心和练习。

conversation_script.text_en: I want to learn more. Can we fix my robot next time?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想学更多。下次我们能修我的机器人吗？

lessons.description: Talking about opening up, trusting family, and having a private conversation with mom.

sentences.english: Mom, can I tell you a secret?
sentences.chinese: 妈妈，我能告诉你一个秘密吗？

sentences.english: I trust you with my feelings.
sentences.chinese: 我信任你，把我的感受告诉你。

sentences.english: I feel worried about something.
Can we talk in private?
I need someone to listen.
You always understand me.
Promise you won't tell anyone?
I feel safe talking to you.
sentences.chinese: 和你谈话我感觉很安全。

sentences.english: Thank you for your comfort.
Sharing secrets makes us closer.
sentences.chinese: 分享秘密让我们更亲近。

conversation_script.text_en: Mom, can I tell you something? It's kind of private.
conversation_script.text_zh: 妈妈，我能告诉你一件事吗？有点私人的。

conversation_script.text_en: Of course, honey. Come sit with me. I am listening.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然，亲爱的。过来坐我身边。我在听。

conversation_script.text_en: I feel worried about my math test tomorrow. I am scared I will fail.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我担心明天的数学考试。我害怕我会考砸。

conversation_script.text_en: It's okay to feel worried. Have you studied?
conversation_script.text_zh: 感到担心是正常的。你学习了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Yes, but I still don't understand some problems.
conversation_script.text_zh: 学了，但我还是有些题不懂。

conversation_script.text_en: Let's look at them together after dinner. I will help you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 晚饭后我们一起看看。我会帮你。

conversation_script.text_en: Really? Thank you, Mom. I feel better already.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？谢谢你，妈妈。我已经感觉好多了。

conversation_script.text_en: You can always share your feelings with me. I am here for you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你总是可以和我分享你的感受。我在这里支持你。

conversation_script.text_en: I promise to try my best. And I trust you to keep this between us.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我保证会尽力。而且我信任你，这是我们之间的秘密。

conversation_script.text_en: I promise. Now let's have a hug, and then we study together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我保证。现在让我们拥抱一下，然后一起学习。

conversation_script.text_en: I love you, Mom. Talking to you always makes me feel safe.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我爱你，妈妈。和你谈话总是让我感觉很安全。

lessons.description: Talking about learning a new skill from dad and spending quality time together.

sentences.english: Dad, can you teach me something new?
sentences.chinese: 爸爸，你能教我点新东西吗？

sentences.english: I want to learn how to ride a bike.
Balance is very important.
Don't be afraid to fall.
Practice makes perfect.
You are doing great!
Keep trying. I will support you.
I am so proud of you.
Learning new things is fun with dad.
sentences.chinese: 和爸爸一起学新东西很有趣。

sentences.english: You are getting better every day.

conversation_script.text_en: Dad, can you teach me how to ride a bike? I really want to learn.
conversation_script.text_zh: 爸爸，你能教我骑自行车吗？我真的很想学。

conversation_script.text_en: Sure! It's a great skill. First, let's find your balance.
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然！这是一项很好的技能。首先，让我们找到平衡。

conversation_script.text_en: I feel a little scared. What if I fall?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我有点害怕。如果我摔倒了怎么办？

conversation_script.text_en: Everyone falls at first. It's part of learning. I will hold the back.
conversation_script.text_zh: 每个人一开始都会摔倒。这是学习的一部分。我会扶着后面。

conversation_script.text_en: Okay, I will try. Here I go!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的，我试试。我来了！

conversation_script.text_en: Good! Pedal slowly and look straight ahead. Don't look down.
conversation_script.text_zh: 很好！慢慢踩踏板，直视前方。不要往下看。

conversation_script.text_en: I am doing it! Wait, I am wobbling!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我做到了！等等，我在摇晃！

conversation_script.text_en: I got you. Don't worry. Try again. You are brave!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我扶着你。别担心。再试一次。你很勇敢！

conversation_script.text_en: I did it! I rode by myself for a few seconds!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我做到了！我自己骑了几秒钟！

conversation_script.text_en: That was amazing! See? Practice makes perfect.
conversation_script.text_zh: 太棒了！看到了吗？熟能生巧。

conversation_script.text_en: Thank you, Dad. I love learning new things with you.
conversation_script.text_zh: 谢谢你，爸爸。我喜欢和你一起学新东西。

conversation_script.text_en: I am so proud of you. Tomorrow we practice again!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我为你感到骄傲。明天我们再练习！

lessons.description: Talking about funny family memories, childhood stories, and sharing laughs together.

sentences.english: Do you remember this funny story?
sentences.chinese: 你记得这个有趣的故事吗？

sentences.english: We laughed so hard that day.
Tell that childhood story again!
sentences.chinese: 再讲一遍那个童年故事！

sentences.english: It was embarrassing but so funny.
I love hearing old family stories.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢听旧的家庭故事。

sentences.english: We couldn't stop giggling.
That joke never gets old.
Sharing memories brings us joy.
sentences.chinese: 分享回忆带给我们快乐。

sentences.english: I remember that moment clearly.
sentences.chinese: 我清楚地记得那个时刻。

sentences.english: Laughing together is the best medicine.

conversation_script.text_en: Hey, do you remember when Dad tried to cook dinner and burned the rice?
conversation_script.text_zh: 嘿，你还记得爸爸尝试做晚饭结果把米饭烧焦了吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Oh yes! That was the funniest night ever. We laughed so hard!
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦是的！那是有史以来最有趣的夜晚。我们笑得好厉害！

conversation_script.text_en: Mom's face was priceless. She didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
conversation_script.text_zh: 妈妈的表情 priceless。她不知道该笑还是该哭。

conversation_script.text_en: And then Dad ordered pizza, and we ate on the floor like a picnic.
conversation_script.text_zh: 然后爸爸点了披萨，我们像野餐一样坐在地上吃。

conversation_script.text_en: I love these old stories. They make me feel warm inside.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我喜欢这些旧故事。它们让我内心感到温暖。

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. Tell me another one! What about your first day of school?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。再讲一个！你上学的第一天怎么样？

conversation_script.text_en: Oh no, that was embarrassing! I wore my shoes on the wrong feet.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦不，那太尴尬了！我把鞋穿反了。

conversation_script.text_en: Really? I didn't know that! Now I have a new story to tease you with.
conversation_script.text_zh: 真的吗？我不知道！现在我有个新故事可以取笑你了。

conversation_script.text_en: Hey! That's supposed to be a secret. But I guess it's too funny to hide.
conversation_script.text_zh: 嘿！那应该是秘密的。但我想它太好笑了，藏不住。

conversation_script.text_en: These moments are what make our family special. Let's keep laughing together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这些时刻让我们的家庭很特别。让我们一起继续笑吧。

conversation_script.text_en: Agreed. Old stories are treasures, and laughter is free!
conversation_script.text_zh: 同意。旧故事是宝藏，而笑声是免费的！

lessons.description: Talking about taking family photos, dressing up, and capturing happy moments together.

sentences.english: It's family photo day!
Everyone, please smile for the camera.
Let's dress up nicely for the photos.
sentences.chinese: 让我们为拍照好好打扮一下。

sentences.english: Which background should we use?
Can you pose like this?
The picture came out great!
Let's capture this happy moment.
sentences.chinese: 让我们捕捉这个快乐的时刻。

sentences.english: We should put this in a frame.
sentences.chinese: 我们应该把这放进相框里。

sentences.english: Photos help us remember good times.
sentences.chinese: 照片帮助我们记住美好时光。

sentences.english: Let's add this to our family album.
sentences.chinese: 让我们把这加进家庭相册里。

conversation_script.text_en: Everyone, it's family photo day! Put on your nice clothes.
conversation_script.text_zh: 大家，今天是家庭拍照日！穿上漂亮的衣服。

conversation_script.text_en: Do I have to wear the tie? It feels tight.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我必须戴领带吗？感觉好紧。

conversation_script.text_en: Just for today. You look very handsome. Now, let's go to the park.
conversation_script.text_zh: 就今天。你看起来很帅。现在，我们去公园吧。

conversation_script.text_en: The park is beautiful. Can we use the flowers as a background?
conversation_script.text_zh: 公园很美。我们能用花做背景吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Perfect idea. Everyone stand together. Big smiles, please!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好主意。大家站在一起。请露出大大的微笑！

conversation_script.text_en: Say cheese! I hope my eyes are open this time.
conversation_script.text_zh: 说茄子！希望这次我的眼睛是睁开的。

conversation_script.text_en: Great shot! Now let's take one with everyone jumping.
conversation_script.text_zh: 拍得好！现在让我们拍一张大家跳起来的。

conversation_script.text_en: That sounds fun! On three, everyone jump!
conversation_script.text_zh: 听起来很有趣！数到三，大家一起跳！

conversation_script.text_en: These photos are amazing. We will treasure them forever.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这些照片太棒了。我们会永远珍藏它们。

conversation_script.text_en: Can we print one and put it in the living room frame?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我们能打印一张放在客厅的相框里吗？

conversation_script.text_en: Of course. Family photo day is always worth it. I love you all!
conversation_script.text_zh: 当然。家庭拍照日总是值得的。我爱你们所有人！

lessons.description: Talking about writing down wishes, dreams, and goals for the future as a family.

sentences.english: Let's make a family wish list.
sentences.chinese: 让我们做一份家庭愿望清单吧。

sentences.english: What is your biggest dream?
I hope we can travel together.
sentences.chinese: 我希望我们能一起旅行。

sentences.english: Write down your goals for this year.
My wish is to learn a new language.
sentences.chinese: 我的愿望是学一门新语言。

sentences.english: We can achieve anything together.
sentences.chinese: 我们一起可以实现任何事。

sentences.english: Let's plan for the future.
I believe in your dreams.
This list is very special to us.
sentences.chinese: 这份清单对我们很特别。

sentences.english: Hopes and dreams make life exciting.
sentences.chinese: 希望和梦想让生活充满 exciting。

conversation_script.text_en: New year is coming. Let's make a family wish list together!
conversation_script.text_zh: 新年要来了。让我们一起做一份家庭愿望清单吧！

conversation_script.text_en: Great idea! I will get paper and pens. What should I write first?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好主意！我去拿纸和笔。我应该先写什么？

conversation_script.text_en: Start with your biggest dream. Mine is to visit the beach together.
conversation_script.text_zh: 从最大的梦想开始。我的是一起去海边。

conversation_script.text_en: I want to learn how to swim. That goes with your beach dream!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想学游泳。这和你的海边梦想很配！

conversation_script.text_en: Perfect! Let's also write down things we want to do as a family.
conversation_script.text_zh: 完美！让我们也写下作为家庭想做的事。

conversation_script.text_en: Like having a picnic every month? Or reading books together?
conversation_script.text_zh: 比如每个月野餐一次？或者一起读书？

conversation_script.text_en: Both! And I hope we can cook dinner together every Sunday.
conversation_script.text_zh: 两个都要！而且我希望我们每个周日一起做饭。

conversation_script.text_en: That's a nice goal. What about personal wishes?
conversation_script.text_zh: 这是个好目标。那个人愿望呢？

conversation_script.text_en: I want to get better at piano. What about you?
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想钢琴弹得更好。你呢？

conversation_script.text_en: I hope to make more friends at school. And I wish for a new bike!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我希望在学校交更多朋友。而且我想要一辆新自行车！

conversation_script.text_en: Let's put this list on the fridge. We can check it every month.
conversation_script.text_zh: 让我们把这份清单贴在冰箱上。我们可以每个月检查。

conversation_script.text_en: Good plan. I believe we can achieve all these dreams together!
conversation_script.text_zh: 好计划。我相信我们可以一起实现所有这些梦想！

lessons.description: Talking about choosing a destination, making travel plans, and getting excited for a family trip.

sentences.english: Let's plan our next vacation.
sentences.chinese: 让我们计划下一次假期吧。

sentences.english: Where do you want to go?
I want to visit the beach.
The mountains are beautiful too.
We need to buy tickets soon.
Let's find a nice hotel.
sentences.chinese: 让我们找一家不错的酒店。

sentences.english: What is our budget for this trip?
sentences.chinese: 这次旅行的预算是多少？

sentences.english: I am so excited for this adventure!
Let's make a schedule for each day.
sentences.chinese: 让我们为每一天做个日程安排。

sentences.english: Family vacations are the best.

conversation_script.text_en: Summer break is coming. Let's plan our family vacation!
conversation_script.text_zh: 暑假要来了。让我们计划家庭假期吧！

conversation_script.text_en: Yes! I have been thinking about it. Where should we go?
conversation_script.text_zh: 好的！我一直在想。我们应该去哪里？

conversation_script.text_en: How about the beach? We can swim and build sandcastles.
conversation_script.text_zh: 海边怎么样？我们可以游泳和堆沙堡。

conversation_script.text_en: Or the mountains? I want to hike and see the views.
conversation_script.text_zh: 或者山里？我想徒步和看风景。

conversation_script.text_en: Both sound great. But we need to check our budget first.
conversation_script.text_zh: 两个听起来都很棒。但我们需要先检查预算。

conversation_script.text_en: True. Maybe the beach is closer and cheaper.
conversation_script.text_zh: 确实。也许海边更近更便宜。

conversation_script.text_en: Good point. Let's look at hotels near the beach online.
conversation_script.text_zh: 说得好。让我们上网看看海边的酒店。

conversation_script.text_en: This one looks nice. It has a pool and free breakfast!
conversation_script.text_zh: 这家看起来不错。有游泳池和免费早餐！

conversation_script.text_en: Perfect! Now we need to buy train tickets.
conversation_script.text_zh: 完美！现在我们需要买火车票。

conversation_script.text_en: I can help with that. I am so excited!
conversation_script.text_zh: 我可以帮忙。我太兴奋了！

conversation_script.text_en: Me too. Let's make a schedule so we don't miss anything fun.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也是。让我们做个日程安排，这样不会错过任何有趣的事。

conversation_script.text_en: This will be the best family vacation ever!
conversation_script.text_zh: 这将是有史以来最棒的家庭假期！

lessons.description: Talking about expressing love, appreciation, and gratitude to family members.

sentences.english: I love you, Mom and Dad.
I appreciate everything you do for me.
sentences.chinese: 我感激你们为我做的一切。

sentences.english: I am grateful for my family.
You mean the world to me.
sentences.chinese: 你对我来说意味着全世界。

sentences.english: Thank you for your love and care.
I am always here for you.
You have my heart forever.
Family love is the strongest.
I support you no matter what.
Together, we can face anything.
sentences.chinese: 在一起，我们可以面对任何事。

conversation_script.text_en: Mom, I want to tell you something important.
conversation_script.text_zh: 妈妈，我想告诉你一件重要的事。

conversation_script.text_en: What is it, sweetie? You can tell me anything.
conversation_script.text_zh: 什么事，亲爱的？你可以告诉我任何事。

conversation_script.text_en: I just want to say... I love you. And I appreciate everything you do.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我只是想说……我爱你。而且我感激你做的一切。

conversation_script.text_en: Oh, that means so much to me. I love you too, more than you know.
conversation_script.text_zh: 哦，这对我意义重大。我也爱你，比你知道的更多。

conversation_script.text_en: You always support me, even when I make mistakes.
conversation_script.text_zh: 你总是支持我，即使我犯了错误。

conversation_script.text_en: That's what family is for. We are always here for each other.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这就是家人的意义。我们永远互相支持。

conversation_script.text_en: I am grateful for Dad too. He works so hard for us.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我也很感激爸爸。他为了我们努力工作。

conversation_script.text_en: He will be happy to hear that. Let's give him a big hug tonight.
conversation_script.text_zh: 听到这个他会很高兴。今晚我们给他一个大大的拥抱吧。

conversation_script.text_en: I want to tell everyone in our family how much I love them.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我想告诉家里每个人我有多爱他们。

conversation_script.text_en: That is beautiful. Love makes our family strong.
conversation_script.text_zh: 这太美了。爱让我们的家庭强大。

conversation_script.text_en: I mean it from the bottom of my heart. You are the best family ever.
conversation_script.text_zh: 我发自内心地说。你们是有史以来最好的家人。

conversation_script.text_en: And you are the best gift we ever received. We love you forever.
conversation_script.text_zh: 而你也是我们收到的最好的礼物。我们永远爱你。
